stem.text: Two enzymes are added to a solution containing a low concentration of a substrate that they can both use.

A.text: Both enzymes will use equal amounts of the substrate.

B.text: Neither enzyme will be able to use the substrate.

C.text: The enzyme with the lower $V_\text{max}$ will use less of the substrate than the other enzyme.

D.text: The enzyme with the lower $V_\text{max}$ will use more of the substrate than the other enzyme.
